---
title: "Install"
---

Python 3.10 or newer.

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/HI-IDN/icename-gender.git
```

That gives you the `icename-gender` command and the `icename_gender` Python package:

```bash
icename-gender --help
```

A snapshot of the register ships with the package, so there is nothing to download before
the first classification, and no network access afterwards.

## From source

```bash
git clone git@github.com:HI-IDN/icename-gender.git
cd icename-gender
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest
```

## As a dependency

In a `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
dependencies = [
    "icename-gender @ git+https://github.com/HI-IDN/icename-gender.git",
]
```
